spans.s:
IN:
I Denoting where: by loc.,
in the house
of Vasudeva:
वसुदेवसद्मनि, Si.; in (the work)
Yogapradipa:
योगप्रदीपे,
V p. com.;
in the first
chapter:
प्रथमेपादे, S. Ph.:
in one place:
एकत्र, Vi.;
in my presence:
पश्यतो मे;
in the hearing of
Sugriva:
शृण्वतः सुग्रीवस्य, Ram.
II Denoting
when: by loc.,
in childhood:
शैशवे, R.;
in the
first or the third year:
प्रथमेऽब्दे तृतीये वा, M.
III
Denoting by what time: by ins., (he)
stu-
died Anuvāka in a day:
अह्नानुवाकोऽधीतः, S. K.;
in twenty years:
विंश्त्या वत्सरैः, Raj. Ph.: in a
short time:
अचिरेण, K.
IV Denoting how: by
ins.,
passing in a balloon:
विमानेन विगाहमानः, R.;
resolving in his mind:
मनसा निश्चित्य, K.;

Anuṣṭubh metre:
आनुष्टुभेन छन्दसा, U.;
in the
style of butterflies:
शालभेन विधिना, Mu.;
in what
manner:
केन प्रकारेण। Vet.:
in rage:
क्रुधा, Si. Ph.:
in short:
किं बहुना, K. V., of direction:
(1) by
ins.,
16 miles in breadth:
विस्तारेण योजनद्वयम्,
Mat.;
(2) better by comp.: v. Length,
breadth.
VI To denote other circumstances:
by loc.,
in deciding:
निर्णये, Mr.
VII The
interior: अभ्यन्तरम्,
took him in:
तमभ्यन्तरं निन्ये,
C.;
go or come in:
अभ्यन्तरं प्रविश, Vi., Mr.
Ph.:
in most cases:
बहुशः; in all likelihood:
प्रायेण, Sa.; “not in man” i.e. not the nature of
man: v. Nature; in that: v. Because;
in consequence of: v. On account of; in the
name of (i.e. on behalf of): -अर्थे
or
-वचनात्।

INN:
(1) पथिकाश्रमः;
(2) पान्थावासः। I. (of court):
मठः (?).
